cliHelp:
UnityStarter, a hub for Unity and Tuanjie.

Usage:
  unitystarter projects [--query text]           list projects
  unitystarter editors                         list installed editors
  unitystarter open <path|name>                open a project in its editor
  unitystarter new <folder> [--editor version] create a project
  unitystarter hub status                      show the hubs taken over
  unitystarter hub sync                        add added projects to the hubs
  unitystarter releases                        list the editors to install
  unitystarter install <version> [--simulate]  install an editor
  unitystarter update                          check for a newer release
  unitystarter version                         print the version

Flags:
  --json      print JSON
  --lang      en or zh-Hans
  --verbose   log to the terminal

With no command, the window opens.
